Frame 9's faceted black ridge fills the middle and the plant is a thin strip. Frame 5's page a flat plate. The genset boxy throughout.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One filmstrip, the 7 to 8 device and the camera walk work. Frames 5 and 9 sit slightly outside.

criteria.why: Every numeral traces. 'residents have filed their own' plural rests on one identified resident. c29 missing from the first comment ids. Frame 4 draws McCloud serving the load beyond Region 1 with no claim on the slide saying so.
